statusLine.command: input=$(cat); pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // 0 | round'); filled=$((pct*10/100)); [ $filled -gt 10 ] && filled=10; bar=''; for i in $(seq 1 10); do if [ $i -le $filled ]; then bar="${bar}█"; else bar="${bar}░"; fi; done; if [ $pct -ge 80 ]; then c=31; elif [ $pct -ge 50 ]; then c=33; else c=32; fi; printf '%s | Contexto: \033[%sm%s\033[0m %s%%' "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name')" "$c" "$bar" "$pct"
